description: Smart meter electricity of a Household in Germany with Electric Vehicle Charging Annotation is a data set deposited in University of Strathclyde by its authors Apostolos Vavouris. Energy consumption data of a single household in Germany, in which an electric vehicle charger is present, for a period of 1 year, timestamped and sampled at 1 minute intervals. Coverage: national (DE); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. Formats: TXT. Size stated: 0KB. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
